specification.title: Shaded Face And Solid Pass
specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.
specification.parent_scope: GPU viewport wireframe/shaded, gem display, camera draw, overlays và mesh tessellation.
specification.parent_exclusions: Không bao gồm offline render/V-Ray studio.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Shaded Face And Solid Pass” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: geometry fixture checks BRep validity/tolerance/closedness or documented intentional open output.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M01: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Shaded Face And Solid Pass”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

execution_design.title: Shaded Face And Solid Pass
execution_design.positive_oracle_proposed: Box shaded faces depth-correct with consistent normals and object colors
execution_design.negative_oracle_proposed: Backface/mirror determinant must not invert normals unnoticed
execution_design.reuse_approval_condition: Audit local checkout at pinned SHA, compile/tests, M00 human legal approval; do not infer ready from static GitHub read.
execution_design.implementation_owner_policy: One owning L2, UI modules dispatch only. No source code changes in vendor-research/ unless approved fork.
objectives: Define typed seam + explicitly testable oracle
Implement one capability at its canonical owner
Verify failure rollback, stable IDs/units/geometry as relevant

boolean_publication_worker_buffers_2026_.scope: Committed single-body Boolean workers prepare exact-source interior-wire/render buffers off UI; fresh-root scene installation checks immutable display identity/fingerprint, pinned source and ownership. Atomic transaction, source geometry, profile tolerances and existing failure guards remain.
boolean_publication_worker_buffers_2026_.measurement: 16 focused tests and 10 native-window release runs passed (8 optimized, 2 same-binary counterfactual). 64 UI final poll High/Light 56.631/42.363 ms medians vs former approximately 2.1 s; 128 single samples 157.735/94.128 ms vs historical approximately 5.1 s.
boolean_publication_worker_buffers_2026_.remaining: Request/creation pauses and variable steady FPS remain; no present/RDP FPS proof, global scene acceptance, full migration or persistence completion.

many_sphere_profile_timing_2026_11_15.scope: 64 spheres with three runs per preset and 128 spheres with one per preset: eight native-window release runs passed source, GPU, restoration and zero-drop checks; 11 focused integration tests passed. Synthetic pointer navigation exercised the actual UI/render path.
many_sphere_profile_timing_2026_11_15.measurement: Both presets approximately 30 encoded FPS under the 30 Hz cap. Light result GPU p50 0.094/0.127 ms vs High 0.309/0.432 ms at 64/128 spheres. Active maximum gaps remain approximately 2.1/5.1 s at final UI publication.
many_sphere_profile_timing_2026_11_15.remaining: Publication stall not fixed; actual client presentation, physical input, larger/general scenes and global L3 acceptance remain open.

light_navigation_smoothness_2026_11_14.scope: Light Shaded navigation reuses Q2 moving targets and restores full-size 4x MSAA. Six matched native-window pointer runs on two spheres and Union passed geometry/target checks; 11 integration tests passed.
light_navigation_smoothness_2026_11_14.measurement: Moving GPU median 0.641 to 0.139 ms; approximately 30 encoded frames/s in both variants, with zero callback gaps above 100 ms from first command through result.
light_navigation_smoothness_2026_11_14.limitations: Synthetic raw pointer events, one small fixture/session, not client presentation or general hardware coverage. Earlier 10.6 FPS was not reproduced in final release comparison; general L3 acceptance remains open.

trim_hole_gpu_2026_11_12.scope: Offscreen GPU renders a reopened trimmed plane in Shaded mode; retained material differs from deleted scene while a hole and an outside point match it. Undo and Redo restore the three sampled pixels; focused GPU test and public source audit pass.
trim_hole_gpu_2026_11_12.limitations: Only three sampled positions on a planar fixture, not full image, boundary pixels, curved surfaces, different cameras or physical desktop. Plan A open; B deferred.

rdp_viewport_pacing_2026_11_15.scope: Remote-session surface presentation bypasses blocking VSync; local sessions keep VSync. Existing CAD clock, source BRep, Boolean tolerance, picking and atomic transactions remain.
rdp_viewport_pacing_2026_11_15.measurement: Ten frozen-release native-window runs passed: two VSync controls at 64 spheres, six default RDP runs at 64, two at 128. Optimized steady encoded FPS 29.987–30.010 across both phases; same-binary controls approximately 10.6 FPS. Eighteen focused tests and public-source audit passed.
rdp_viewport_pacing_2026_11_15.remaining: Creation/request/publication pauses and high synthetic UI callback activity remain. Client displayed FPS, local-console/dynamic-session coverage, all-overlap/general scenes and full source/persistence migration are not established.
rdp_viewport_pacing_2026_11_15.next_action: Profile remaining source capture/registration and UI repaint load while preserving exact source; broaden physical input/client presentation coverage separately from encoded FPS.

coupled_document_ab_2026_11_15.scope: Same-binary reconstructed coupled document/display lifetime, validation and serialization versus independent representations. Quality, exact kernel, UI worker publication, GPU caching and RDP policy held constant; normal product remains separated.
coupled_document_ab_2026_11_15.measurement: 16/16 frozen-release native-window runs and 19 focused integration tests passed. 64 high UI final poll 216.7→53.5 ms (75.3% less); 64 light UI final poll 41.3→24.6 ms (40.5% less); 128 high UI final poll 486.0→151.8 ms (68.8% less); 128 light UI final poll 125.5→91.8 ms (26.9% less). Exact output source SHA and per-profile display counts matched. Both architectures stayed near 30 encoded FPS under the same cap; no material steady-FPS gain or consistent total Boolean speedup was established. High creation totals fell about 49/52 percent. Worst 128-sphere request pauses remain about 600/450 ms High/Light.
coupled_document_ab_2026_11_15.remaining: Scoped reconstructed coupling, not a wholesale historical runtime rollback. 30-Hz cap, synthetic input, general scenes/native families, client video FPS and full migration/persistence remain outside evidence.
coupled_document_ab_2026_11_15.next_action: Use the separated product path; profile residual request/creation pauses independently of kernel mathematics and RDP presentation.

boolean_request_source_batch_2026_11_15.scope: Existing atomic source batch admission replaces per-operand retained-owner scans in shared Boolean request constructor. Exact source, stamps/placement, quotas, guards, native mathematics, display density and publication policies retained.
boolean_request_source_batch_2026_11_15.measurement: 20 focused integration tests and 16/16 same-binary native-window release runs passed. 64 high request 47.5→2.5 ms (94.7% less), worst active 182.3→138.7 ms; 64 light request 46.2→3.4 ms (92.7% less), worst active 86.6→86.5 ms; 128 high request 365.8→8.9 ms (97.6% less), worst active 626.5→266.1 ms; 128 light request 365.0→8.7 ms (97.6% less), worst active 447.3→210.2 ms. Exact native result source SHA and per-profile mesh counts matched. Both paths remain near 30 steady encoded FPS.
boolean_request_source_batch_2026_11_15.remaining: Foreground selection/redraw, creation/fitting, worker admission and publication pauses remain. Large-scene Union fixtures only; full migration/persistence, arbitrary geometry and client-presented FPS remain open. Optional debug probe was interrupted and not counted as a passed test.
boolean_request_source_batch_2026_11_15.next_action: Profile selection_frame projection and associated redraw separately from the now-short Boolean request, preserving geometry and exact selection visuals.
